verdict.rationale: Render documents AI-driven suggestions from your infrastructure data, such as an agent inspecting CPU and memory metrics, recommending a compute plan and applying it after approval. This runs through external coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) using Render's MCP server and official skills, not natively inside the Render product. Missing for 10: native in-dashboard AI insights or suggestions, AI analysis of logs and metrics without third-party agents, independent or hands-on corroboration.
